adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the importer now does `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` instead of `PostCreator.new(..., created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), ...)`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` -> `TopicEmbed.import` does not pass any `created_at`, so the created topic/post will default to the import time. Also `TopicEmbed.import` begins with `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, so non-http(s) `t[:link]` causes a nil return; the Disqus importer only proceeds with comments inside `if post.present?`, so those threads' comments will be skipped with no explicit error handling in the shown code.
